summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - AI Model Pose Generator ## Introduction This video introduces the AI model posture generator function for everyone. In the newly released 2025.0 version, we have launched a powerful new function, the AI model posture generator. This new function allows us to manually adjust the joints without any need to input a text prompt or upload images. AI will be able to simply and quickly generate the model posture you want. ## Getting Started First, select the virtual model, AI model posture generator in the menu bar. If there is a virtual model or costume in the 3D window of the software, a warning window will pop up, asking if you want to continue running the AI model posture generator. If you choose to run, all virtual models and costumes in the 3D window will be deleted. Before choosing to run, please save the current work content or open a new project file. ## AI Model Posture Generator Window In the AI model posture generator window, there are two methods to choose from: **prompt words** and **images**. ### Using Prompt Words When using prompt words, you can input the necessary description or select a keyword to generate images. The first option is gender; you can choose between women or men according to your needs. Next is the keyword prompt, where you can enter the description text you want to generate. On the right side of the prompt window, there are three different icons representing different functions: 1. **Keyword Suggestion**: After clicking it, it will display a recommended list of keywords that we can use. When clicking one of the keywords, it will automatically be added to the prompt window and displayed in blue font. 2. **Delete Keyword**: If you want to delete the keyword, you only need to click the X on the right side of the keyword under the prompt window or click the keyword again in the keyword suggestion to cancel the selection. 3. **Random Generation**: When you want to find inspiration or ideas, you can use this function. ### Keeping Input and Modifying Prompts Even if you use the same prompt, the AI model posture generator will generate different new images every time. However, if you activate the second big arrow, which is the keyword function to keep the input, it will keep the previously generated image as much as possible while using the new keyword prompt to generate updates. If you want to change the prompt, you can click the icon in the upper right corner of the prompt window, similar to an eraser, to clear the prompt and reset all the content. Alternatively, use the keyword function to keep the input for the existing prompt and make detailed adjustments. After editing, click **Start Generation**. The AI model posture generator will create images based on the prompt. ## Example Walkthrough If you are satisfied with the generated image, please click **Save**. It can be exported as a posture file for further use. Now let's create a new model posture according to the steps we just introduced. 1. Set the gender as **male**. 2. In the list of keywords recommended by the keyword prompt, select the keyword **tennis**. This means that we will eventually show the posture of a tennis player. 3. Enter a detailed description: "A tennis player's side wave, showing the tension of speed and the player." Everything is ready. Click **Start Generation** to create the image. If you like the generated image, you can apply the posture in the image as a virtual model posture. ### Modifying Generated Images If you want to re-enter the description text in the prompt box, you can click **Clear Prompt**. If you just need to make some adjustments, open the keyword to keep the input and then update the prompt. Click **Start Generation** again, and it will use the current image as the basis for the new image generated. For example, if we want to raise the arm based on the current image, we first click the keyword to keep the input. Then, in the prompt box, add a new short word to modify the posture: "Raise the arm higher." Once the final image is generated and reflects the posture you want, click **Start Generation** at the bottom of the window to change the image posture to a virtual model posture. ## History Record Click **History Record** on the right side of the window to check all the images generated. If there is an image you want to save in the history record, select it directly and then click **Save** in the upper right corner. Set up the save path. After clicking **Save**, a PNG-shaped image will be saved. You can also select all the images and save them all by clicking **Save** after confirming there are no issues. ## Using Existing Image Files Now let's see how to use an existing image file to create a virtual model posture. Select a woman and then click the upload button to select the image to be applied and click **Open**. The image will be added. After successfully adding the image file, click at the bottom of the window to start generating and change the image to a model posture. After confirming that the generated posture is fine, click **Save** to save it as a posture file. ## Applying Saved Posture Files Next, let's apply the saved posture file to the virtual model. Close the window of the AI model posture generator. You can import any female model from the library or open the project file you want to apply the posture. Click on the file to open the posture, select the just saved posture file, and open it. In the open posture window that is displayed, you can use the posture file after confirming that the virtual model has been applied. ## Conclusion Using the AI model posture generator, all you need is a line of text or a reference image. The reference image can be easily created. It is a posture that is natural and expressive when used in fashion, clothing, and exercise. ```
